themes_detail.label: Street Lighting Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints surged to 24 this week, a 129% spike above the 10.5-complaint weekly average, signaling potential widespread outages or maintenance failures across the Upper West Side.
evidence: 24 street light complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (129% increase, z-score: 4.32)
High-severity statistical anomaly indicating acute infrastructure degradation
Safety implications for evening/night pedestrians and cyclists
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection to confirm outages and repair timeline
Interview residents about dark blocks and documented safety concerns (mugging, accidents)

themes_detail.label: Curb Damage Spike Across District
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints exploded to 11 this week, a 267% jump from the 3-complaint weekly baseline, suggesting either a concentrated infrastructure failure or newly visible damage patterns in the neighborhood.
evidence: 11 curb condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.0 weekly average (267% increase, z-score: 5.66)
Highest z-score spike in dataset, indicating statistically extreme anomaly
Potential secondary effect of winter weather, heavy vehicle traffic, or deferred maintenance
reporting_angles: Request 311 complaint locations to map geography of damage—single area vs. district-wide pattern
Verify whether recent road work or utility access holes are triggering complaints

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Problem Emerges
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints jumped to 6 this week, a 700% spike from the 0.8 weekly average, marking a sudden and significant degradation of park conditions as weather warms.
evidence: 6 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 3.77)
Timing coincides with spring season and likely increased park usage
Suggests organized events, late-night gatherings, or amplified music becoming neighborhood friction point
reporting_angles: Identify which parks (Central Park, Riverside Park sections) are complaint hotspots
Interview park-goers and nearby residents about specific noise sources (concerts, sports leagues, late-night parties)
Cross-reference with Parks Department event permits filed this month

themes_detail.label: Unlicensed Cannabis Retail Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked 967% two weeks ago (4 complaints vs. 0.4 weekly average), indicating rapid proliferation of illegal dispensaries in the Upper West Side—a policy enforcement and public health concern.
evidence: 4 cannabis retailer complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% increase, z-score: 5.21)
Represents either new storefronts or newly-reported existing operations
Likely reflects post-legalization enforcement gap between state law and unlicensed retail
reporting_angles: Map locations of reported illegal dispensaries—are they concentrated on specific blocks or avenues?
Interview NYPD about enforcement actions and coordination with state cannabis licensing authority
Profile a community member complaint—why are residents frustrated (youth access, odor, loitering)?
Compare UWS complaint volume to other Manhattan districts to assess whether this is a neighborhood-specific problem

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaint Wave
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints surged to 11 two weeks ago, a 700% spike from the 1.4 weekly average, signaling emerging friction over restaurant sidewalk seating, noise, and pedestrian access as spring activates the district's dining scene.
evidence: 11 outdoor dining complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 5.16)
Seasonal pattern but magnitude suggests new restaurants or enforcement of existing violations
Reflects ongoing post-pandemic tension over sidewalk seating reclamation
reporting_angles: Identify which restaurants/blocks are repeat complaint sources via 311 geolocation data
Interview neighbors about specific grievances (noise, blocked sidewalk access, hygiene)
Check with Community Board for pending outdoor dining permits or hearings
